column1: # The relpath is submodule-relative (src/main/resources/...) and the
# cell text must match the flagged `menuOption menuTarget objectID`
# cell exactly. Upstream authors some interaction-only transports
# with menu option + target but no object id; the plugin tolerates
# them (the column is ignored by the pathfinding parser and only
# substring-matched for display), and the transportAnchorDrift
# detector reports them in its advisory unparseable bucket. These
# rows are the committed baseline debt — new no-id cells still flag.
